rdf_content.name: CochleaNet Low-Resolution IHC Segmentation
rdf_content.description: 3D U-Net for the instance segmentation of inner hair cells (IHCs) in lower-resolution light-sheet microscopy of cleared cochleae, stained for Myosin VIIa, calretinin (CR) or VGlut3. It predicts the foreground probability, the distance to the object center, and the distance to the object boundary. A seeded watershed turns these maps into IHC instances. Trained on annotated mouse and marmoset cochleae at about 1.89 x 1.89 x 3.0 um voxel size (x, y, z).
